components.description: One semester of release from teaching and service at full salary and benefits for a regular faculty member who certifies providing at least half of the child's care; ends within twelve months of the birth, adoption or foster placement; thesis and dissertation advising continues; research not named (continues, R4b/R4c).

notes: Governing documents: the Faculty Code (Nov 2015 printing, amendments through June 18, 2015; captured 2018-05) and the Faculty Handbook (April 2015; captured 2016-05) both state the Parental Childcare Leave for regular faculty, so missing is false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply). No later version of either is saved; both are read as in force on 2018-02-22.

Parental Childcare Leave (c1): one semester of release from teaching and service at full salary; research not named, so it continues (R4b) and the relief category is Just teaching (R4c, which names this provision); advising of existing thesis and dissertation students continues by default. Semester length 14 weeks from Handbook 3.16.
The HR Paid Parental Leave policy (c14, six weeks) covers staff, residents and grant-funded Specialized Faculty; it directs regular faculty to the Faculty Code and is flagged excludes_main_faculty.

Voluntary Short-Term Disability (employee-paid, 60% up to $3,000/week for up to 150 days after 30 days) is for full-time faculty with less than two years of service and part-time faculty; per U8 the two-year member is on the GW Paid STD path (c11), so the voluntary plan is recorded here only. Resident Temporary Disability Leave (residents only, terms not stated) is likewise noted, not coded.

Sabbatical leave (Faculty Code VI.B; Handbook 2.5.4, 2.10) requires a research or study program and is not a parental provision; defense leave and partial retirement are unrelated. Back-Up Family Care (five days per year) is a care service, not leave.

Cited but not saved: the GW university FMLA policy; the university sick and annual leave policy; Summary of Benefits - GW Paid STD (PDF) and the GW Paid STD Certificate Booklet; Summary of Benefits - Voluntary STD and its booklet; the DC Parental Leave page; the Personal Leave page (HR and Benefits navigation); FMLA for the Employee's Own Serious Health Condition and FMLA for the Care of a Family Member pages; Benefits Continuation during FMLA, Rights & Responsibilities, Reinstatement pages; the Leave of Absence Timekeeping Process (PDF); Advocacy Resources for Expecting Parents (PDF); the statement of sabbatical leave policy; NIH Childcare Provisions and NSF Career Life Balance; the Faculty Organization Plan; the Resident manual; collective bargaining agreements (SEIU Local 500 part-time faculty).

Chain, birth parent: Parental Childcare Leave, one semester (14 weeks) at full salary from the start, with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start (S1); GW Paid STD (generic plan, 100%, up to 166 calendar days) concurrent with FMLA after a 2-week waiting period.
Chain, non-birth parent: Parental Childcare Leave, one semester at full salary, with FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start.
